records.figureReview: Complete XML and rendered diagram read: V vertical,I horizontal, straight line throughorigin,DeltaV/DeltaI triangle labelledR. Markedpoints coincide withline within subpixel rendering precision; no numeric axis calibration or pixel-based resistance assigned.
records.manualArithmetic: The source assigns symbolic relations, not compulsory numerical data. Current is signed net charge divided by time (or its instantaneous rate); negative electron charge times opposite signed carrier flux yields the conventional direction. Combining J=E/rho, E=V/length and I=JA gives R=rho*length/area. Differentiate V=RI versus I=V/R to distinguish slopeR from1/R. Constructed manual probes:6C/3s=2A, -6C/3s=-2A,6V/3ohm=2A, lengthfactor2 doublesR and radiusfactor2 givesonequarterR. The polynomial heating probe has slope1+3I² rather than a constant: it is outside the fixed-temperature ohmic model, not a claim that the lesson requires this derivative.
records.pedagogicalReview: Separates reference direction from electron motion; defines ideal generator and axis-dependent slope before formula manipulation; fixes temperature and geometry for resistivity law. No numerical work is waived merely because the record has no answer field.
records.physicalAssumptions: Current relative to chosen section direction; average ratio for finite interval, constant-current shortcut only when constant. Ohmic material at fixed assigned temperature. Uniform homogeneous wire, positive finite length/cross-section/resistivity. DeltaV in resistor law is explicitly a passive voltage drop, not unqualified VB-VA. Ideal generator fixes voltage, not current.

records.figureReview: Complete XML/render: leftR1/R2 lie on a single unbranched A-B path; rightbranches both terminate atsameA/B buses, without wire shorting eitherresistor. Symbols and lengths are schematic, not numeric resistance scales.
records.manualArithmetic: Source derivations: common seriesI givesV=I(R1+R2); common parallelV givesI=V(1/R1+1/R2). ThusReq=R1R2/(R1+R2), with positive gapsRi-Req. SubstituteOhm intoVI to obtainI²R andV²/R, retaining passive signs. ConstantP givesE=P*duration; varyingP requires integral. Constructed manual probes:2+3=5ohm, inverse(1/2+1/3)=6/5ohm,6V*2A=12W and12W*3s=36J. ForP(t)=2t over0..3s the integral is9J, not endpointP timesduration18J. Across separate trials at fixed sourceV a series memberP1=V²R1/(R1+R2)² is nonmonotonic; the source compares commonI within a series circuit and does not assert unchangedI when loadchanges.
records.pedagogicalReview: Defines topology through node connections rather than drawn proximity; derives equivalents; compares power only after identifying held-current or held-voltage constraint. Constant-power energy qualifier is explicit.
records.physicalAssumptions: Ideal wires define equipotential nodes, lumped quasi-static/steady resistive circuit without accumulating nodal charge. Positive finite linear resistances. Series requires an unbranched shared node; parallel requires same two nodes. VI is absorbed power under passive convention; E=P*duration only for constantP. CommonI/commonV comparisons concern components under the stated constraint.

records.figureReview: Complete XML/render: upperplate+Q,lower-Q; five separated downward arrows frompositive towardnegative, gapd andfacingareaA. Thin drawnplate thickness andquote are schematic, no metric values inferred frompixels. Captionstatesfielddirection andarea/gap meaning.
records.manualArithmetic: Source formulas deriveC=Q/V=epsilon*A/d fromE=Q/(epsilon*A), V=Ed. Linear charging has integral0..Q q/C dq=Q²/(2C)=QV/2=CV²/2; platecharge magnitudeQ is not2Q. Constructed manual probeC2F,V3V givesQ6C,U9J. A dielectricfactor2 givesC4F: isolatedQ6C givesU9/2J; connectedV3V givesU18J. UnderfixedV batteryworkV*DeltaQ=18J whilefieldincrease9J, leaving9J for mechanical energy in the ideal quasistatic insertion limit. The source explicitly asks to include generator and possible mechanical work; no numerical epsilon0 calculation is assigned. Printed epsilon0 is explicitly approximate.
records.pedagogicalReview: Defines plate charge and magnitude of voltage, then geometric model and charging-energy triangle. Distinguishes isolated from source-connected insertion and includes external energy transfers instead of claiming dielectric always lowers stored energy.
records.physicalAssumptions: Linear constant capacitance and uniform linear dielectric with positive permittivity, plateslarge compared to gap and field considered away from edges. Q is magnitude on one plate; potential difference magnitude. Quasistatic electrostatic energy, no leakage/breakdown or fringing correction asserted. FixedQ and fixedV constraints are distinct; external source/mechanical energy included where present.

records.figureReview: Complete XML/render: lefttwo separated capacitorplate pairs inseries, middlewirejoinsinnerplatesonly; righttwo capacitors sharethetwo buses. Wiresstopattheplate gaps, no shorts. LabelsC1/C2 not encoded throughgeometric scale; neutral-middle condition is in accompanyingcaption/text.
records.manualArithmetic: Source derivesparallelCsum fromQsum atcommonV; neutralfloatingmiddleimpliesoppositecharges andseries1/C=sum1/Ci. Constructed2F/3F probe givesCparallel5F andCseries6/5F. For source-disconnected joining, finalV=(C1V1+C2V2)/(C1+C2) uses algebraic charges; initialminusfinalU=C1C2(V1-V2)²/[2(C1+C2)]>=0. EqualV giveszero loss;equalC andoppositeV givesfinalzero. If middlenode initiallyhaschargeQmiddle, adjacentplatecharges differbyQmiddle: this boundaryprobe lies outside the explicit neutral-node premise. No required numerical transient integration appears in the lesson.
records.pedagogicalReview: Makes the often-missed initially-neutral middle-node condition explicit. Joining rule conserves signed groupcharge and permits energy dissipation, without claiming energy conservation only in the electric field. Contrasts resistor/capacitor equivalent formulas after physical derivations.
records.physicalAssumptions: Positive finite linear capacitors and ideal-wire node model. Series floating middle node is initially neutral and isolated, explicitly in source. Charge conserved separately on each isolated joined conductor group, with polarity signs. Final commonV after a real settling transient; an undamped ideal LC oscillation is not assumed settled. Zero energy loss is possible for equal initial voltage.
